item.title: Youth report: Stags U18 2-1 Doncaster U18
item.description: Mansfield Town under-18s added another three points to their Youth Alliance League tally on Saturday, as they secured a 2-1 victory over Doncaster Rovers at RH Academy. Winger Jayden Chambers-Morgan handed the young Stags the lead in the 25th minute before midfielder Josh Walters doubled their advantage. item.title: Stags to face Arsenal in Emirates FA Cup fifth round
item.description: Mansfield Town have been drawn at home to Premier League leaders Arsenal in the Emirates FA Cup fifth round. Stags only ever meeting with Arsenal came in the FA Cup in January 1929 at Highbury. The match will take place on the weekend of Saturday 07 March. Ticket information will be announced in due course.

item.title: Report: Blackpool 1-0 Stags
item.description: Mansfield Town slipped to a narrow 1-0 defeat on the road this evening at Bloomfield Road against Blackpool. It was Niall Ennis’ first-half goal that proved decisive with Stags unable to break down their resolute opponents, who went on to claim maximum points in Sky Bet League One. Mansfield returned to Lancashire to face the Tangerines after Saturday’s historic 2-1 FA Cup victory at Turf Moor against Premier League side Burnley.
